verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions punctuation, casing, or number formatting in transcripts, and documents no option to turn such formatting off. The output-format parameter (srt, vtt, webvtt, or JSON) is a related but different control, so it earns no credit. This is a fair question for a speech-to-text API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off
